newsAll.head: Drew Lock: Returning to No. 2 role
newsAll.body: Lock will return to a backup role for Sunday's game at Washington after coach Mike Macdonald said Friday that Sam Darnold (glute) is "going to play," John Boyle of the Seahawks' official site reports.

newsAll.head: Dallas Goedert: No practice again Friday
DeVonta Smith: Limited at Friday's practice
newsAll.body: Smith (hamstring) practiced in a limited capacity Friday.

newsAll.head: Saquon Barkley: Full practice Friday
newsAll.body: Barkley (stinger) was a full practice participant Friday.

newsAll.head: Saquon Barkley: Will wear protective gear Monday
newsAll.body: Barkley (stinger) said Friday that he's "feeling good" this week and will wear protective gear around his neck during Monday's contest at Chicago, Dave Zangaro of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.
